notes.subject: מות יומת
notes.rationale: Infinitive-absolute 'die he shall die' — rendered 'bai ol i kilim i dai tru'.

notes.subject: הנפש
notes.rationale: nefesh here is 'the person/breathing one' — rendered 'man', not 'soul'.

notes.subject: עמיה
notes.rationale: 'his people' folded into 'ol manmeri bilong en' in the cutting-off idiom.

notes.subject: katim … i go ausait
notes.rationale: כרת is the idiom of being cut off from the community; rendered per D4c 'katim em i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en'.

translation: Na yupela ken lukautim gut ⟨את⟩ Sabat, long wanem, em i samting holi bilong yupela. Man i bagarapim em, bai ol i kilim i dai tru, long wanem, man i mekim wok long em — bai ol i katim ⟨em⟩ i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en, man ⟩.

tokens.gloss: bai ol i kilim i dai tru
bai ol i katim i go ausait
i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en
